data.define: Slang for food that tastes amazing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'bussin' about a cold, bland sandwich.

data.l1_hook: Pasta buatan ibu terasa luar biasa malam ini! "bussin".

native.tip: “bussin” = enak banget; mantap; lezat. Contoh: “Mom's pasta is bussin tonight.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “bussin”?
“bussin” = enak banget; mantap; lezat.
Contoh: “Mom's pasta is bussin tonight.” (Pasta buatan ibu "bussin" malam ini.)
